covered_report_window: Tuesday, August 25, 2026 after the U.S. market close through Wednesday, August 26, 2026 before the U.S. market open.
market_context_summary: Risk appetite is cautious ahead of Nvidia and Friday's Fed speech; August consumer confidence fell to a seven-month low, July retail sales weakened, and Wednesday's 8:30 a.m. ET GDP, durable-goods, income and PCE releases can overwhelm company-specific premarket reactions. Oil eased, but Iran tensions and U.S.-Canada tariff retaliation remain active macro risks.

ranked_companies.timing: Aug. 26 before open; 9:00 a.m. ET call
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Backlog, organic growth, adjusted EBITDA margin and FY27 revenue guidance
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Premium valuation and an in-line rather than raised guide
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record backlog and fiber/data-center demand support another constructive print, but the multiple requires a fresh guide-up rather than confirmation alone.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $1.98 billion of revenue and $4.70-$4.72 of adjusted EPS, with the market focused on whether backlog and annual guidance rise again.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Backlog converts cleanly, organic Communications growth stays strong, margins expand and FY27 guidance rises.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Acquisition mix or execution caps margins and management only reiterates despite a very high backlog bar.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: The stock trades at roughly 35 times trailing earnings after a major infrastructure rerating; the event bar is higher than published consensus.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Current previews are constructive and model revenue growth above 40%, but the decisive issue is the forward guide rather than headline EPS.

ranked_companies.timing: Aug. 26 before open; materials from 7:00 a.m. ET
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Coffee segment profit and FY27 EPS guidance
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Volume/mix weakness or renewed Hostess pressure
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Coffee cost relief and lower interest expense create a credible earnings-recovery path if volume/mix and Sweet Baked Snacks do not deteriorate.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $2.21-$2.22 EPS on $2.13 billion of revenue versus management's roughly flat organic sales and mid-teens Q1 adjusted-EPS growth framework.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Coffee pricing finally outruns input costs, Hostess stabilizes and management holds or raises its $9.75-$10.25 FY27 EPS range.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Coffee volumes weaken, marketing absorbs the cost benefit or Hostess undermines margin recovery.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: The stock rerated after June guidance but still carries a moderate valuation and less event crowding than the high-growth names.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The FY27 EPS midpoint began above the prior LSEG consensus, and current previews emphasize cost deflation rather than top-line acceleration.

ranked_companies.timing: Aug. 26 before open; 10:00 a.m. ET call
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Adjusted operating margin and fiscal 2027 outlook
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Conservative FY27 guide or Facet integration drag
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Aftermarket resilience and operating leverage support upside if the new fiscal-year outlook validates record margin durability.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $1.04 billion of sales and $1.13 EPS, up roughly 10% year over year on both measures.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Aftermarket and Industrial growth sustain gross-margin gains and FY27 guidance extends the margin record.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Mobile normalization, acquisition costs or a cautious FY27 framework make the quarter look peak-like.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: At about 25 times trailing earnings, valuation is full but not as extreme as the AI-linked cyclicals.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The prior $3.94-$4.01 FY26 adjusted-EPS range was narrowed around record margins; current previews lean constructive.

ranked_companies.timing: Aug. 25 after close; 5:00 p.m. ET call
ranked_companies.expected_driver: RPO, billings, net retention and Enterprise Advanced adoption
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: AI narrative outpacing durable ARR acceleration
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Double-digit revenue and RPO growth plus Enterprise Advanced adoption can support a modest upside reaction if retention improves again.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $319 million of revenue and $0.40 adjusted EPS, just above the company's $0.39 EPS guide.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: RPO and billings accelerate, retention improves and Enterprise Advanced expands average deal size.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Revenue beats narrowly while billings, retention or forward growth remain merely stable.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Positioning appears less crowded than premium software peers, and the stock is near the low-$30s rather than a post-earnings spike.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Current previews skew slightly bullish, but published consensus sits close to management's guide and leaves limited EPS surprise value.

ranked_companies.timing: Aug. 25 after close; 4:30 p.m. ET call
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Data-center revenue mix, gross margin and Q3 outlook
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: AI growth already priced into a 22% implied move
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: AI-networking demand supports strong growth, but the reaction needs a data-center and margin guide that clears a very elevated real bar.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Wall Street expects about $328.6 million of revenue and $0.61 EPS, roughly 27.5% year-over-year revenue growth and a sharp sequential increase.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: FiberEdge and 1.6T ramps lift data-center mix, gross margin moves toward the long-term target and Q3 guides above consensus.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: The divestiture complicates comparisons, gross margin lags or management delivers only the already-expected AI acceleration.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Monthly options imply about a 22% move and the stock has rerated sharply; this is the window's clearest priced-for-performance setup.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Current previews expect strong growth and the prior quarter beat, but the bar has moved with the AI-networking narrative.

ranked_companies.timing: Aug. 25 after close; 4:30 p.m. ET call
ranked_companies.expected_driver: FY27 guide and Global Business Solutions growth
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: TurboTax DIY weakness and another guidance-led selloff
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: The valuation and expectations have reset after the prior selloff, leaving relief upside if FY27 guidance confirms durable QuickBooks and Credit Karma growth.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $3.58 EPS; Q3 raised full-year revenue guidance after TurboTax revenue rose 7% and Credit Karma rose 15%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Global Business Solutions and Credit Karma stay strong, TurboTax pressure is contained and FY27 guidance de-risks growth.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: DIY tax weakness, free-filing competition or cautious FY27 commentary overwhelms another reported-quarter beat.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Weekly options imply about 9.4%-9.7%; the prior report produced a roughly 20% decline despite a beat, proving guidance risk is real.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The company raised FY26 revenue and non-GAAP guidance in Q3, but investor attention has shifted to segment quality and FY27.

ranked_companies.timing: Aug. 26 before open; 8:00 a.m. ET call
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Vehicle gross margin and Q3 delivery guidance
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Low bar and sequential stabilization squeeze
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Delivery pressure and a deeply negative operating margin leave the base setup bearish unless gross margin stabilizes much faster than feared.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Q2 revenue is expected near RMB25.1 billion, down about 17% year over year, after Q1 gross margin fell to 7.9% and operating margin to negative 13%.

ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Price competition keeps vehicle margin weak, losses persist and delivery guidance fails to show recovery.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: The stock is already depressed near $12, which increases relief-rally risk even if the fundamental read remains negative.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Current institutional previews are cautious and emphasize stabilization rather than growth; company Q2 revenue guidance was below the earlier consensus.

ranked_companies.timing: Aug. 26 before open; results about 7:30 a.m. ET
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Brand comps, gross margin and FY26 guide
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Tariff absorption and a higher post-Q1 expectation bar
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Healthy demand, low valuation and a 2%-4% Q2 sales-growth guide support upside, but tariff-sensitive margins determine whether the beat is high quality.

ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Hollister and Abercrombie both grow, AUR holds and gross margin absorbs tariffs better than planned.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Sales are fine but tariffs and promotions weaken the operating-margin and full-year outlook.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Weekly implied move is roughly 13%; short interest is about 10%, leaving some squeeze support but also a demanding volatility hurdle.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Published EPS consensus is close to the top of management's Q2 range, so a modest beat alone may not be enough.
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Existing tariff and forward-guide override applied

ranked_companies.timing: Aug. 26 before open; 8:30 a.m. ET call

ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Published key-metric estimates imply RPO growth, but the reaction depends on guidance acceleration.
